description: Open a browser task that keeps one page and login across calls, then drive it with alterlab_task_act and alterlab_task_observe. Pass start_url and the session handle from alterlab_connect. mode=read (default) blocks every action that changes something on the site; mode=write allows them, and each change waits for the user's approval. The task ends at its TTL.

allowed_domains.description: Extra domains the task may visit

instruction.description: The user's own words for this task. account_create is refused unless it names the site.

session_id.description: Session handle from alterlab_connect or alterlab_sessions

name: alterlab_task_start
title: Start Browser Task
